rief Receive axis preset values from control. \details The values are based on the machine zero point/machine coordinate system. Preset values are in mm or degree. ote Require LSV2Login(): ::PW_INSPECT. ote There are ::LSV2_MAX_AXES numbers of axes over LSV2 supported. \param [in] hPort is the handle for the connection. \param [in] PresetEntry is the preset entry on control. \param [in,out] lpAxesCount is the number of elements in lpAxesPresetBuf. The buffer has to exist with the correct size. If the lpAxesCount < number of axes, then the function returns FALSE and the number of axes will be set as output parameter in lpAxesCount.

The order of the values depends on the type of control: - iTNC530: The order of the values is the same as the machine axes order defined in MP100. - NCK based controls: The order of the values is the composition of the CfgChannelAxes\progAxis and the programmed axes of the active kinematic model defined in CfgKinSimpleModel\progAxes (alphabetically ordered).
Example: - CfgChannelAxes\progAxis = [Y, X, Z] - CfgKinSimpleModel\progAxes = [B, A, C] - then the Result is: [Y, X, Z, A, B, C] etval TRUE if successfully received. etval FALSE on error. ote If LSV2ReceivePresetData() == FALSE, then this error codes are possible (receive last error with GetLastError()): - ::T_ER_NO_PRIV: \copybrief ::T_ER_NO_PRIV - ::T_ER_BAD_FORMAT \copybrief ::T_ER_BAD_FORMAT - ::T_ER_WRONG_PARA: \copybrief ::T_ER_WRONG_PARA \see With LSV2ReceiveRunInfo() and type LSV2_RUNINFO_AXES_CONFIG, the axes names, ids and types can be received. \internal Telegramm-Struktur: R_PS -+- S_PS | +- T_ER
